sourceCopy.name: Original Name Generator
sourceCopy.title: Fantasy Name Generator Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Generate fantasy names, business ideas or usernames with a reusable seed. Free, no account, no availability claims.
sourceCopy.intro: Make a fresh list of fantasy-style names, business-name ideas or usernames. Set a seed to reproduce a list, or change it for another draw.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does the name generator work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose a name style, result count and optional keyword, then generate. The seed makes the same settings reproducible. Results come from built-in word and syllable lists and are suggestions, not verified names.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does this generator check business names or usernames online?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Everything is generated in this browser. It does not search trademark registries, social platforms or domain services, and it does not upload or save your input.

fields.keywordHint: Used as a starting word for business and username ideas.
fields.seedHint: Reuse the same seed and settings to get the same list.
fields.suggestionNote: Suggestions only: availability, trademarks, usernames and domains are not checked. Search and verify a name before using it.

messages.copyUnavailable: Copy is unavailable in this browser.
messages.checkInputs: Check the name style, count, keyword and seed.
messages.seedUnavailable: Secure random seed generation is unavailable. Enter a seed to continue.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use a generated business name?
additionalFaqs.answer: You can consider it as an idea, but this tool does not check trademarks, existing businesses, usernames or domains. Verify availability and legal requirements before using a name commercially.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I get the same name list again?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Keep the same style, count, keyword and seed. Changing any of those settings can change the generated list.
